name.fr: Évaluation du certificat (APS, VPD ou ZAB)
Certificat officiel de compétence en anglais

evidence.quote: University entrance qualification, entrance qualification for universities of applied sciences, vocational qualification or foreign educational certificate
International applicants require a certificate assessment (APS certificate, VPD from uniassist or evaluation of the ZAB).
English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.:

notes: The application deadline 30 September 2026 and the tuition fee €1,500 per semester are for applicants from all countries / non-EU countries respectively. No minimum German level is required for admission; German A1/A2 courses are integrated, and if preparatory German is needed it is a manual check. APS certificate is only required for applicants from China, Vietnam and India.

note.en: Check whether your Moroccan diploma is recognised as equivalent to the German Abitur via the DAAD admission database.

note.en: Check whether you need an APS certificate and a uni-assist VPD for your Moroccan diploma.

note.fr: Demandez une VPD à uni-assist au moins 4 à 6 semaines avant la date limite de candidature.
note.en: Apply for a uni-assist VPD at least 4 to 6 weeks before the application deadline.

evidence.quote: Bitte plane etwa vier bis sechs Wochen für die Bewertung ein. Reiche deine Unterlagen frühzeitig ein.
